capabilities: Run Claude Code and Antigravity CLI sessions as parallel sidebar terminal tabs
Track, resume, fork and search sessions from a per-vault session list
Render Claude conversations as a readable note view with clickable wikilinks
Show per-session model, effort, context fill and usage-limit bars
Send notes, selections and files to an agent session
disambiguation: It does not implement its own AI agent; it hosts the official Claude Code and Antigravity command-line tools in a pseudo-terminal.
extras: macOS only (Windows not supported) and needs Python 3 to run its pseudo-terminal helper; the plugin itself sends no network traffic and has no telemetry, but the agents it runs talk to Anthropic and Google servers; agents can modify vault files and the plugin adds no sandbox of its own; not affiliated with Anthropic, Google or Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian has no way to run terminal-based AI agent sessions next to your notes or track, resume and search them per vault.

relations.evidence: It starts the official command-line tools in a real pseudo-terminal
Run Claude Code and Antigravity in a real terminal in Obsidian's right sidebar
The terminal is xterm.js (MIT license, Copyright (c) The xterm.js authors)

requires.name: Claude subscription or API access, or a Google account for Antigravity

summary: Runs the Claude Code and Antigravity command-line agents in a real terminal in the sidebar, with a session list, reading view and usage limits.
